data.name: Lopika
data.gender_notes: Lopika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Lopika is the name of the goddess Lakshmi who left her footprints on the earth. The name Lopika is derived from the words 'lopa' meaning 'feet' and 'pada' meaning 'foot'. This name signifies the blessings and prosperity that come from the goddess Lakshmi. The name Lopika carries the meaning “Lotus Footprints” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lopika usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus footprints and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessings of Lakshmi, Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity
data.etymology: Lopika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lotus Footprints.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lopika total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
